paths.title: HTML Foundations: build your first real web pages
paths.tagline: From a blank file to complete, well-structured pages — every element explained, every lesson practiced in a live editor
paths.description: Start from absolute zero: what HTML is, how browsers read it, and how to structure a document. Master headings, paragraphs, text formatting, quotations, links, file paths, images, lists, block vs inline elements, classes and ids, the head section, colors, character entities and emoji. Every lesson has full theory on the left and a live code editor with instant feedback on the right, and the path ends with a complete profile-page project.

paths.title: HTML Intermediate: semantic layouts, tables, forms and media
paths.tagline: The working core of real websites — semantic structure, every form control, data tables, video, audio and embeds
paths.description: Move from single pages to real site structure. Learn semantic layout with header, nav, main, section, article, aside and footer; build accessible data tables; master forms end to end — every input type, every attribute, built-in validation, datalist, meter and progress; embed video, audio, captions, iframes and third-party content safely; and finish with a complete registration-form project. Full theory plus a live editor with automatic checks in every lesson.

paths.title: HTML Advanced: accessibility, APIs and professional practice
paths.tagline: Everything senior developers know — ARIA, responsive images, SEO metadata, SVG, canvas, web components and browser APIs
paths.description: Complete your HTML mastery. Go deep on global and data attributes, responsive images with srcset and picture, SEO and social metadata, accessibility with ARIA and keyboard focus, modern interactive elements like details and dialog, SVG and canvas graphics, template and slot, drag and drop, geolocation, web storage, web workers and server-sent events. Close with professional style-guide conventions, debugging and validation, and a full multi-section site project built in the live editor.
